comment: Investigated Questie/PandaBase mismatches for the Dwarf and Gnome sagas (issue #13), the Night Elf saga (issue #14), The Missing Diplomat (issue #38) the Tauren saga (issue #17) and the Forsaken saga and Horde spine (issue #18) and the Horde spine from level 18 to level 60. PandaBase shows Forever; the pinned QuestieDB v1.0.16 does not. tests/test_race_sagas.py checks that each route still meets the prerequisites of both sources, and the neutral chains (issue #19) and the dungeon codas and reputations (issue #20), and the zone side catalogues (issue #21).
